result.summary: Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-004.md covering all 5 REQ-004 acceptance criteria plus a supporting rendered-page check, following REQ-002's structure (script-based checks) and REQ-003's route/viewport conventions. AC1 (non-empty/translated values except untranslatable literals): independently re-derived the identical-value diff between messages/en.json and messages/ru.json (node script) -- confirmed exactly 18 identical keys, matching CONTENT-BA's and REVIEWER's claimed count precisely; each of the 18 individually justified as a literal (country/role codes, already-English job titles, brand/contact literals, a numeric value, an acronym). AC2 (no Cyrillic): node regex script, confirmed 0 matches against the current file. AC3 (domain vocabulary verbatim): node script counting occurrences of all 9 terms plus specific key/value assertions (Nav.events, Nav.chapters, Creed.principle2Body, Band.lede, Doors.door2Body, MapSection.ctaLaunchChapter/nodeAlmatySub) -- all verified against the actual current file content, not guessed. AC4 (status labels lowercase): node script dumping all 8 status keys' current values plus the CSS text-transform:uppercase rule confirmation (globals.css:152) plus a rendered curl/grep case against /en with exact expected 8-line output. AC5 (no exclamation/slogan/emoji): grep for '!' (confirmed exit 1, no matches), node emoji-range regex script (confirmed 0 matches), plus a manual slogan spot-check case with concrete example values (Band.title, Doors.title, Partners.cta) verified against the file. AC6 (supporting, rendered-page completeness): next-intl error-marker checks on /en and /ru control, 4 spot-check strings across 4 namespaces (Nav, Hero t.rich(), Doors, Footer) with exact expected HTML verified against REQ-003's precedent pattern, plus a full 12-section x 4-viewport/theme-combination content-completeness case per qa_testing_guide.md §5. Every script command in the spec was actually run during authoring and its real output recorded as the Expected value -- no case is speculative.
